kashika: कडारसंशब्दनात् प्राग् यानित ऊर्ध्वमनुक्रमिष्यामः, ते समाससंज्ञा वेदितव्याः। वक्ष्यति — <<यथासादृश्ये>> [[२.१.७]] — यथावृद्धं ब्राह्मणानामन्त्रयस्व। प्राग्वचनं संज्ञासमावेशार्थम्। समासप्रदेशाः — <<तृतीयासमासे>> [[१.१.३०]] इत्येवमादयः॥
kashikaEnglish: From here through 2.2.38, what we describe is called samāsa (compound). The term samāsa must be supplied in each relevant sūtra.
englishShort: The समास term is discussed from this sutra onwards till the end of second पाद of the second chapter.
englishFull:
From here through @ref[2.2.38], everything described receives the designation समास (compound).

This is an अधिकार (governing rule). The word समास is to be supplied in all subsequent sūtras in this section.

The word प्राक् "up to" indicates the scope extends forward to the specified limit.
